summary: Space Exploration Holdings argues that E‑Rate should not fund overbuilding of commercial broadband, should remain competitively neutral, and should only use self‑construction when no competitive option exists. Space Exploration Technologies Corp. argues that E‑Rate should remain open to all broadband providers, not limited to ETCs or rural areas, and that duplicative high‑cost subsidies should be retired while keeping bidding open to all technologies.
